news.title: UI launches national search for chief financial officer
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa has begun a national search for its next chief financial officer, who will serve as the university's senior financial strategist and report directly to the president. The search follows last month’s announcement by current vice president and CFO Terry Johnson that he will retire in April after 33 years at the university. Read more about the search committee and the elevated

news.title: Sandra Daack-Hirsch named associate provost for faculty
news.summary_en: Sandra Daack-Hirsch, professor and Dr. Rita and David Frantz Executive Associate Dean in the UI College of Nursing, has been named associate provost for faculty in the Office of the Provost. Daack-Hirsch began serving in the role part time on Sept. 1 and will transition to full time later in the academic year.

news.title: More than a water tower: How UI's new standpipe keeps campus running
news.summary_en: The UI’s new water tower is hard to miss. Located near Kinnick Stadium and UI Health Care University campus, the distinctive standpipe rises about 138 feet — roughly the height of a 13-story building — and has become a new campus landmark. Learn more about why the new, larger water tower was needed.

news.title: New AI Discovery Initiative to help you explore, build skills with AI
news.summary_en: The University of Iowa is launching a new effort to spark the next chapter of AI integration for its employees. The AI Discovery Initiative will expand access to AI tools, professional development, and collaborative learning to help you build skills and confidence with AI.

news.title: Why you receive research recruitment emails and how to opt out
news.summary_en: The research recruitment emails you receive serve an important purpose. Finding participants for more than 4,000 active research projects is critical to the university’s mission. But if the messages are becoming too much, learn how you can adjust your email preferences to opt out.

news.title: See how our newest Hawkeyes kicked off the fall 2026 semester
news.summary_en: From Kickoff at Kinnick’s silent disco to yard games at Hubbard Park, the first week of classes was filled with excitement. As students settled in, they also looked ahead to opportunities such as research and study abroad. Watch this video recap of the UI welcoming new and returning students to campus for fall 2026.

news.title: Students help tell the Hawkeye story in new game-day commercial
news.summary_en: Students take center stage in the UI’s new national TV spot, which will air during Hawkeye sporting events this year. Meet the Hawkeyes featured in the commercial and hear about what makes the Iowa experience so valuable. Go Hawks!

news.title: 2026 Distinguished Alumni Award recipients include Marilynne Robinson
news.summary_en: From Pulitzer Prize winners to Olympic Games advisors, meet the six Distinguished Alumni Award honorees who exemplify the Hawkeye tradition of excellence. The UI’s highest alumni honor this year includes decorated and influential writer Marilynne Robinson.

news.title: Study: Periodical cicadas may be doomed to extinction
news.summary_en: University of Iowa researchers have determined that periodical cicadas, insect swarms that emerge from the ground every 13 or 17 years, may go extinct. The primary reasons are the removal of old forests, upon which the cicadas depend for food, and that cicadas disperse only very short distances when they emerge.
